gloss: to forget completely; to put out of one's mind

definitions.gloss: to forget completely; to put behind one
definitions.explanation: To forget something entirely, so that it is gone from memory, sometimes on purpose. Very common in the passive: {忘|わす}れ{去|さ}られる (to be forgotten).

examples.japanese: ⟦{嫌|いや}→嫌：10232_iya⟧な⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{忘|わす}れ{去|さ}る。
examples.english: To put bad memories behind one.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{忘|わす}れ{去|さ}られて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: That incident has now been completely forgotten.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だった⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{忘|わす}れ{去|さ}られてしまうこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even singers who were once popular can be forgotten by the public when the times change.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {忘|わす}れ{去|さ}られる: to be forgotten (by people, by history)
- {忘|わす}れ{去|さ}られた~: a forgotten ~
- ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{忘|わす}れ{去|さ}る: to put the past behind one

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧: to forget — the everyday verb; {忘|わす}れ{去|さ}る adds completeness and a slightly literary tone
